description:
# COMMIT PHASE

## Goal
Create a clean git commit with the changes.

## Task Context
Add always-visible quick action chip bar to chat with direct tool invocation (no LLM). Customers tap a chip, it calls the tool handler directly and returns formatted results.

## Changes Required

### New: src/app/pages/home/components/ChatQuickActions.tsx
Horizontal-scroll chip bar rendered above the chat input. Actions:
- 'What is fresh?' → tool: list_catch, args: {}
- 'Market schedule' → tool: get_markets, args: { activeOnly: true }
- 'Upcoming popups' → tool: get_vendor_popups, args: {}
- 'Place an order' → direct link to /orders/new (not AI, just navigation)
- 'Ask AI' → placeholder chip, visually muted/disabled for now (wired in Phase 3)

Style: pill buttons in horizontal scroll container. overflow-x: auto, scrollbar-width: none, gap: var(--space-sm). Pills use --color-surface-secondary bg, --color-text-primary text, --radius-full. Pressed state: --color-action-primary bg, --color-text-inverse text. 'Place an order' uses --color-action-secondary (coral).

### New: src/chat/tool-formatter.ts
Simple template-based formatter per tool. Converts raw JSON tool results into readable chat text. No LLM call.
- list_catch: 'Here is what is fresh today:\n• Mahi — caught this morning\n• ...' with headline and summary
- get_markets: 'Market schedule:\n• Adobe Ranch — Saturdays 8am-12pm\n• ...'  
- get_vendor_popups: 'Upcoming popups:\n• Spring Festival — April 15\n• ...'
Handle empty results gracefully ('No catch available right now', 'No upcoming popups', etc.)

### src/chat/durableObject.ts
New handler in webSocketMessage for type: ai-action:
```
interface AiActionMessage { type: 'ai-action'; tool: string; args: Record<string, unknown>; }
```
Flow:
1. Validate tool name is in allowed customer tools list (list_catch, get_markets, get_vendor_popups)
2. Budget check via McpDO (reuse existing pattern from handleAiResponse)
3. Call tool handler directly from src/api/tool-handlers.ts (handleListCatch, handleGetMarkets, handleGetVendorPopups)
4. Format result using tool-formatter.ts
5. Persist as senderType: 'ai' message in D1
6. Broadcast to all sockets

### src/app/pages/home/components/ChatSheet.tsx
- Import and render ChatQuickActions between message area and input form
- On chip tap: send { type: 'ai-action', tool, args } via WebSocket
- Also insert an optimistic customer-style message (e.g. 'What is fresh today?') so the thread reads naturally
- 'Place an order' chip navigates to /orders/new instead of sending WS message

## Test Steps
1. Open chat — verify quick action chips visible above input at all times.
2. Tap 'What is fresh?' — verify optimistic customer message appears, then AI response with formatted catch data.
3. Tap 'Market schedule' — verify formatted market list appears as AI message.
4. Tap 'Upcoming popups' — verify formatted popup list or 'No upcoming popups' message.
5. Tap 'Place an order' — verify navigation to /orders/new page.
6. Verify 'Ask AI' chip is visible but muted/disabled.
7. Test with no catch data available — verify graceful 'No catch available' message.
8. Test budget exhaustion — verify friendly fallback message when McpDO budget check fails.
9. Verify quick actions work during active vendor conversation (not suppressed by takeover).
10. Horizontal scroll works on mobile — chips don't wrap, can scroll to see all.
11. Verify tool results are NOT going through LLM — check no Workers AI calls in logs for quick actions.
12. Verify AI messages from quick actions have senderType: 'ai' and show the AI label in chat.

# VERIFICATION PHASE

## Goal
Validate that the implementation works correctly through automated AND manual verification.

Add always-visible quick action chip bar to chat with direct tool invocation (no LLM). Customers tap a chip, it calls the tool handler directly and returns formatted results.

Horizontal-scroll chip bar rendered above the chat input. Actions:
- 'What is fresh?' → tool: list_catch, args: {}
- 'Market schedule' → tool: get_markets, args: { activeOnly: true }
- 'Upcoming popups' → tool: get_vendor_popups, args: {}
- 'Place an order' → direct link to /orders/new (not AI, just navigation)
- 'Ask AI' → placeholder chip, visually muted/disabled for now (wired in Phase 3)

Style: pill buttons in horizontal scroll container. overflow-x: auto, scrollbar-width: none, gap: var(--space-sm). Pills use --color-surface-secondary bg, --color-text-primary text, --radius-full. Pressed state: --color-action-primary bg, --color-text-inverse text. 'Place an order' uses --color-action-secondary (coral).

### New: src/chat/tool-formatter.ts
Simple template-based formatter per tool. Converts raw JSON tool results into readable chat text. No LLM call.
- list_catch: 'Here is what is fresh today:\n• Mahi — caught this morning\n• ...' with headline and summary
- get_markets: 'Market schedule:\n• Adobe Ranch — Saturdays 8am-12pm\n• ...'  
- get_vendor_popups: 'Upcoming popups:\n• Spring Festival — April 15\n• ...'
Handle empty results gracefully ('No catch available right now', 'No upcoming popups', etc.)

```
interface AiActionMessage { type: 'ai-action'; tool: string; args: Record<string, unknown>; }
```
Flow:
1. Validate tool name is in allowed customer tools list (list_catch, get_markets, get_vendor_popups)
2. Budget check via McpDO (reuse existing pattern from handleAiResponse)
3. Call tool handler directly from src/api/tool-handlers.ts (handleListCatch, handleGetMarkets, handleGetVendorPopups)

5. Tap 'Place an order' — verify navigation to /orders/new page.
6. Verify 'Ask AI' chip is visible but muted/disabled.
7. Test with no catch data available — verify graceful 'No catch available' message.
8. Test budget exhaustion — verify friendly fallback message when McpDO budget check fails.
9. Verify quick actions work during active vendor conversation (not suppressed by takeover).
10. Horizontal scroll works on mobile — chips don't wrap, can scroll to see all.
11. Verify tool results are NOT going through LLM — check no Workers AI calls in logs for quick actions.
12. Verify AI messages from quick actions have senderType: 'ai' and show the AI label in chat.

title: Implement Voice tool registry + buildCommandPrompt
description:
# IMPLEMENTATION PHASE

## Goal
Make the code changes to implement the feature/fix.

## Task Context
Create the voice tool registry that defines all voice actions and generates LLM system prompts. This is the architectural seam: Phase 1 generates prompts, Phase 3 becomes Agents SDK tool definitions.

Create src/api/voice-tools.ts:
- Export voiceTools registry object with these tools:
  update_catch: { description: "Update today's fresh catch with what's available", schema: { headline, items[], summary }, reviewType: "catch" }
  create_market: { description: "Add a new recurring market", schema: { name, schedule, locationDetails?, customerInfo?, catchPreview? }, reviewType: "market-create" }
  create_popup: { description: "Create a temporary popup market event", schema: { name, schedule, expiresAt, locationDetails?, customerInfo?, catchPreview? }, reviewType: "popup-create" }
  update_market: { description: "Update details on an existing market (name match)", schema: { marketId, ...partial fields }, reviewType: "market-update" }
  update_market_catch: { description: "Update what fish are available at a specific market", schema: { marketId, catchPreview }, reviewType: "market-catch" }

- Export function buildCommandPrompt(tools, businessContext):
  - Generates system prompt from registry descriptions + schemas
  - Injects current date (new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]) for relative date resolution
  - Injects business context: list of existing markets (name, id, type, schedule, active)
  - Instructs LLM: return { intent, confidence, data, interpretation }
  - interpretation = human-readable summary ("Update catch preview for Folly Beach Market")
  - If sounds temporary/one-time → type is popup, resolve relative dates to absolute
  - Role-based filtering: accept role param, filter tools by role (admin sees all)

- Export type VoiceCommandResult = { intent: string, confidence: number, data: Record<string, unknown>, interpretation: string }

## Test Steps
1. buildCommandPrompt generates valid prompt containing all tool descriptions
2. Business context (markets list) appears in generated prompt
3. Current date injected correctly
4. Schema shapes described clearly in prompt for LLM
5. Role filtering: non-admin role gets filtered tool list
6. VoiceCommandResult type exported and usable
7. Registry is extensible (adding a new tool is just adding an entry)

### New: src/chat/tool-formatter.ts
Simple template-based formatter per tool. Converts raw JSON tool results into readable chat text. No LLM call.
- list_catch: 'Here is what is fresh today:\n• Mahi — caught this morning\n• ...' with headline and summary
- get_markets: 'Market schedule:\n• Adobe Ranch — Saturdays 8am-12pm\n• ...'  
- get_vendor_popups: 'Upcoming popups:\n• Spring Festival — April 15\n• ...'
Handle empty results gracefully ('No catch available right now', 'No upcoming popups', etc.)

### src/chat/durableObject.ts
New handler in webSocketMessage for type: ai-action:
```
interface AiActionMessage { type: 'ai-action'; tool: string; args: Record<string, unknown>; }
```
Flow:
1. Validate tool name is in allowed customer tools list (list_catch, get_markets, get_vendor_popups)
2. Budget check via McpDO (reuse existing pattern from handleAiResponse)
3. Call tool handler directly from src/api/tool-handlers.ts (handleListCatch, handleGetMarkets, handleGetVendorPopups)

6. Broadcast to all sockets

### src/app/pages/home/components/ChatSheet.tsx
- Import and render ChatQuickActions between message area and input form
- On chip tap: send { type: 'ai-action', tool, args } via WebSocket
- Also insert an optimistic customer-style message (e.g. 'What is fresh today?') so the thread reads naturally

5. Tap 'Place an order' — verify navigation to /orders/new page.
6. Verify 'Ask AI' chip is visible but muted/disabled.
7. Test with no catch data available — verify graceful 'No catch available' message.
8. Test budget exhaustion — verify friendly fallback message when McpDO budget check fails.
9. Verify quick actions work during active vendor conversation (not suppressed by takeover).
10. Horizontal scroll works on mobile — chips don't wrap, can scroll to see all.
11. Verify tool results are NOT going through LLM — check no Workers AI calls in logs for quick actions.

description:

## Goal

## Task Context
Implement cost control measures for Claude API usage:

1. Model routing: Route simple queries (catch listing, market schedule, single-tool lookups) to claude-haiku. Route complex queries (multi-step, order help, ambiguous) to claude-sonnet. Classification based on query complexity heuristic.

title: Commit Customer FreshSheet Display
description:
# COMMIT PHASE

## Goal
Create a clean git commit with the changes.

## Task Context
## Overview
Build the customer-facing FreshSheet component that displays Evan's formatted catch data on the home page. Integrate with the existing home page, replacing the hero section when fresh catch data exists. Include staleness auto-expiry (>7 days falls back to FreshHero).

## Part 1: FreshSheet Component (src/app/pages/home/components/FreshSheet.tsx)

### Design
- Ocean gradient card matching existing FreshHero style language:
  - `background: var(--color-gradient-primary)` (ocean blue → mint)
  - `border-radius: var(--radius-xl)`, `box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg)`
  - White text (--color-text-inverse)
  - Same width/margin as FreshHero: `width: calc(100% - var(--space-md) * 2)`, `max-width: var(--width-md)`, centered

### Content Structure
- "This Week's Catch" label at top (uppercase, small, letter-spaced — same as FreshHero V1 pattern)
- Headline from Claude output (large, bold, --font-size-4xl)
- Item list: each item shows fish name + Evan's descriptive note
  - e.g., "Redfish — beautiful fillets, just pulled in"
  - Use glassmorphic item cards or simple styled list items
  - Each item on its own line, readable
- "Updated X hours ago" relative timestamp at bottom
  - Use simple relative time calculation (no library needed)
  - "just now", "1 hour ago", "2 days ago", etc.
- "Order Now" CTA button at bottom
  - Links to /orders/new
  - Use coral gradient or action-secondary styling for prominence
  - Should stand out as the primary action

### Props Interface
```ts
type CatchData = {
  headline: string;
  items: { name: string; note: string }[];
  summary: string;
  updatedAt: string; // ISO date string
};
```

### Component is NOT "use client"
- This is a presentational component with no interactivity (no useState, no onClick handlers that need client)
- The "Order Now" button is just an `<a>` tag
- Relative timestamp can be computed at render time (server component)
- Keep it as a server component unless client interactivity is needed

## Part 2: Barrel Export
- Add to `src/app/pages/home/components/index.ts`:
  `export { FreshSheet } from './FreshSheet';`

## Part 3: Home Page Integration

### CustomerHome.tsx (server component)
- After fetching markets, also fetch latest live CatchUpdate for the org:
  ```ts
  const catchUpdate = await db.catchUpdate.findFirst({
    where: { organizationId: orgId, status: "live" },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }
  });
  ```
- Staleness check: only pass if ≤7 days old
  ```ts
  const STALE_DAYS = 7;
  const isStale = catchUpdate && (Date.now() - new Date(catchUpdate.createdAt).getTime()) > STALE_DAYS * 86400000;
  const catchData = catchUpdate && !isStale ? JSON.parse(catchUpdate.formattedContent) : null;
  ```
- Pass `catchData` (with updatedAt from catchUpdate.createdAt) to CustomerHomeUI
- Also pass existing props (markets, freshCatch, quickActions, ctx)

### CustomerHomeUI.tsx (client component)
- Add `catchData` to props type (CatchData | null)
- Conditional render in the hero section:
  - If catchData exists: `<FreshSheet catch={catchData} />`
  - If catchData is null: `<FreshHero actions={quickActions} />` (existing fallback)
- Import FreshSheet from ./components

## Test Steps
1. With live CatchUpdate (≤7d old) in DB: home page shows FreshSheet with formatted catch
2. FreshSheet shows "This Week's Catch" label, headline, items with notes
3. Each item displays fish name and Evan's note (e.g., "Redfish — beautiful fillets")
4. "Updated X hours ago" timestamp is accurate
5. "Order Now" button visible and links to /orders/new
6. With live CatchUpdate >7 days old: home page shows FreshHero fallback (quick actions)
7. Without any CatchUpdate: home page shows FreshHero with quick actions
8. Ocean gradient card matches existing hero aesthetic
9. Mobile: component looks good at 375px width
10. Text is readable (white on gradient, proper contrast)
11. Verify no client-side JavaScript needed (pure server component)

If approaching 30-40% context usage with remaining work, create continuation beads for remaining items and exit cleanly.

title: Get bearings for Admin Catch Recording UI
description:
# BEARINGS PHASE

## Goal
1. Verify the codebase is in a healthy state
2. Understand the relevant code for this task

## Task Context
## Overview
Build the admin catch recording page (/admin/catch) with a massive dock-friendly mic button, integrate with the audio processing API (built in a prior task), add the dashboard nav card, and register the route. This is the full admin-side UI for voice-to-catch.

## Part 1: Admin Catch Page (Server Component)

### CatchPage.tsx (src/app/pages/admin/catch/CatchPage.tsx)
- Server component following existing pattern (see MarketConfigPage.tsx as reference)
- Auth check: hasAdminAccess(ctx), return appropriate error components if not
- Fetch latest live CatchUpdate for org: `db.catchUpdate.findFirst({ where: { organizationId: ctx.currentOrganization.id, status: "live" }, orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" } })`
- Pass currentCatch (or null) + ctx to CatchUI client component

## Part 2: Admin Catch UI (Client Component)

### CatchUI.tsx (src/app/pages/admin/catch/CatchUI.tsx)
- "use client" component
- State machine with states: idle | recording | processing | done | error | permission-denied

### Mic Button (centerpiece)
- 120px+ diameter circle, `border-radius: var(--radius-full)`
- Idle: ocean blue (`var(--color-action-primary)`), mic icon (SVG or emoji)
- Text below: "Tap to record what's fresh"
- Must be easy to tap with a big thumb on a dock

### Recording State
- Pulsing red ring animation (CSS keyframes)
- 2-minute countdown timer display (mm:ss format)
- Audio level indicator: use AudioContext + AnalyserNode
  - Connect MediaStream source to AnalyserNode
  - Read frequency data in requestAnimationFrame loop
  - Map amplitude to visual feedback (ring glow intensity or thickness pulsing with voice)
  - Evan needs to SEE the mic is picking up sound over dock wind/noise
- Auto-stop AND auto-submit at 0:00 (same behavior as manual stop)
- Text: "Recording... Tap to stop"

### MediaRecorder Integration
- MIME type detection: `MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported()`
  - Prefer `audio/webm;codecs=opus` (Chrome, Android)
  - Fallback: `audio/mp4` (Safari, iOS)
  - Fallback: `audio/webm`
- getUserMedia: `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: { echoCancellation: true, noiseSuppression: true } })`
- On stop: convert blob to ArrayBuffer, POST to /api/catch/record
- Release mic tracks on stop: `stream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop())`

### Error State (CRITICAL for dock use)
- RETAIN audio blob in memory on upload failure
- "Retry" button: re-uploads the SAME recording (no re-recording needed)
- "Re-record" button: separate, discards blob, returns to idle
- Error message displayed clearly
- Critical for spotty dock signal — don't lose a 2-minute recording on failure

### Permission Denied State
- Handle navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia rejection
- Show explanation: "Microphone access is needed to record your catch update"
- Instructions to re-enable in browser settings
- Retry button to request permission again

### Processing State
- Spinner animation
- Text: "Transcribing & formatting..."
- Non-interactive (no cancel, let it complete)

### Done State
- Green checkmark or success indicator
- Show formatted catch result (headline, item list, summary)
- "Re-record" button to start over
- "Clear catch" button to archive current live catch without replacing

### Current Live Catch Display
- Below the mic button area
- "Currently showing to customers:" header
- Render the current live catch data if exists
- Show "No catch currently displayed" if none

### Clear Catch
- Button that archives current live catch without recording new one
- Calls clearCatch() server function
- Use case: off-season, or Evan wants to stop showing catch

## Part 3: Server Functions (src/app/pages/admin/catch/catch-functions.ts)
- "use server" module
- `clearCatch()`: archives current live catch for org, calls revalidatePath("/")
- Follow existing server function patterns: requestInfo, hasAdminAccess check, return { success, error? }

## Part 4: Styles (src/app/pages/admin/catch/catch.css)
- BEM-like naming: `.catch-mic`, `.catch-mic__ring`, `.catch-mic__ring--recording`, `.catch-mic__timer`, `.catch-result`, etc.
- Use semantic design tokens ONLY (var(--color-*), var(--space-*), var(--radius-*))
- @keyframes for pulse animation (recording state)
- @keyframes for amplitude visualization
- Mobile-first: big touch targets, readable on small screens
- @media (max-width: 640px) adjustments if needed

## Part 5: Dashboard Nav Card + Route Registration

### AdminDashboardUI.tsx
- Add 4th nav card to the existing grid:
  - Icon: 🎙️ (microphone emoji)
  - Title: "Fresh Catch"
  - Description: "Record what's available this week"
  - Link: /admin/catch

### routes.ts (src/app/pages/admin/routes.ts)
- Import CatchPage from ./catch/CatchPage
- Add: route("/catch", CatchPage)

## Test Steps
1. Navigate to /admin/catch as admin user — page loads with mic button
2. See big mic button in idle state (120px+, ocean blue)
3. Tap mic — browser requests microphone permission
4. Grant permission — see recording state: red pulsing ring, countdown from 2:00
5. See audio level indicator responding to voice input (visual amplitude)
6. Tap again to stop — see processing spinner ("Transcribing & formatting...")
7. After processing: see formatted catch result with headline, items, summary
8. See "Re-record" button in done state
9. Wait 2 minutes while recording — auto-stops and auto-submits
10. Simulate upload failure: see error with both "Retry" and "Re-record" buttons
11. Tap "Retry" — re-uploads same audio without re-recording
12. Test "Clear catch" — archives current catch
13. Deny mic permission — see helpful permission-denied message with instructions
14. Navigate to /admin — see 4th "Fresh Catch" card with mic icon
15. Click "Fresh Catch" card — navigates to /admin/catch
16. Test on mobile viewport: mic button easy to tap with thumb
17. Verify all styles use semantic design tokens (no hardcoded hex)

title: Diagnose Global RSC error boundary
description:
# DIAGNOSIS PHASE

## Goal
Understand the bug and find the root cause. Report findings back to orchestrator.

## Bug Context
Unhandled exceptions in server functions/components crash RSC streaming, returning raw 500s with null response body → client whitescreen. No catch-all error handling exists. Fix: add error boundary wrapping in src/worker.tsx around RSC render, and ensure src/app/Document.tsx has a fallback error UI. On error, return a meaningful error page instead of whitescreen. Related issues: #19, #18, #15, #6.

2. Intentionally throw in a server function — should show error, not whitescreen

5. Verify error is logged server-side with request context
6. Test error boundary on both admin and customer routes
7. Test that navigation after an error works (user can recover without full refresh)
8. Verify error page uses design system tokens for consistent styling
9. Test on mobile Safari and desktop Chrome
10. Confirm 500 status code is still returned (for monitoring) but with HTML body

title: Implement Admin Catch Recording UI
description:
# IMPLEMENTATION PHASE

## Goal
Make the code changes to implement the feature/fix.

## Task Context
## Overview
Build the admin catch recording page (/admin/catch) with a massive dock-friendly mic button, integrate with the audio processing API (built in a prior task), add the dashboard nav card, and register the route. This is the full admin-side UI for voice-to-catch.

## Part 1: Admin Catch Page (Server Component)

### CatchPage.tsx (src/app/pages/admin/catch/CatchPage.tsx)
- Server component following existing pattern (see MarketConfigPage.tsx as reference)
- Auth check: hasAdminAccess(ctx), return appropriate error components if not
- Fetch latest live CatchUpdate for org: `db.catchUpdate.findFirst({ where: { organizationId: ctx.currentOrganization.id, status: "live" }, orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" } })`
- Pass currentCatch (or null) + ctx to CatchUI client component

## Part 2: Admin Catch UI (Client Component)

### CatchUI.tsx (src/app/pages/admin/catch/CatchUI.tsx)
- "use client" component
- State machine with states: idle | recording | processing | done | error | permission-denied

### Mic Button (centerpiece)
- 120px+ diameter circle, `border-radius: var(--radius-full)`
- Idle: ocean blue (`var(--color-action-primary)`), mic icon (SVG or emoji)
- Text below: "Tap to record what's fresh"
- Must be easy to tap with a big thumb on a dock

### Recording State
- Pulsing red ring animation (CSS keyframes)
- 2-minute countdown timer display (mm:ss format)
- Audio level indicator: use AudioContext + AnalyserNode
  - Connect MediaStream source to AnalyserNode
  - Read frequency data in requestAnimationFrame loop
  - Map amplitude to visual feedback (ring glow intensity or thickness pulsing with voice)
  - Evan needs to SEE the mic is picking up sound over dock wind/noise
- Auto-stop AND auto-submit at 0:00 (same behavior as manual stop)
- Text: "Recording... Tap to stop"

### MediaRecorder Integration
- MIME type detection: `MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported()`
  - Prefer `audio/webm;codecs=opus` (Chrome, Android)
  - Fallback: `audio/mp4` (Safari, iOS)
  - Fallback: `audio/webm`
- getUserMedia: `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: { echoCancellation: true, noiseSuppression: true } })`
- On stop: convert blob to ArrayBuffer, POST to /api/catch/record
- Release mic tracks on stop: `stream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop())`

### Error State (CRITICAL for dock use)
- RETAIN audio blob in memory on upload failure
- "Retry" button: re-uploads the SAME recording (no re-recording needed)
- "Re-record" button: separate, discards blob, returns to idle
- Error message displayed clearly
- Critical for spotty dock signal — don't lose a 2-minute recording on failure

### Permission Denied State
- Handle navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia rejection
- Show explanation: "Microphone access is needed to record your catch update"
- Instructions to re-enable in browser settings
- Retry button to request permission again

### Processing State
- Spinner animation
- Text: "Transcribing & formatting..."
- Non-interactive (no cancel, let it complete)

### Done State
- Green checkmark or success indicator
- Show formatted catch result (headline, item list, summary)
- "Re-record" button to start over
- "Clear catch" button to archive current live catch without replacing

### Current Live Catch Display
- Below the mic button area
- "Currently showing to customers:" header
- Render the current live catch data if exists
- Show "No catch currently displayed" if none

### Clear Catch
- Button that archives current live catch without recording new one
- Calls clearCatch() server function
- Use case: off-season, or Evan wants to stop showing catch

## Part 3: Server Functions (src/app/pages/admin/catch/catch-functions.ts)
- "use server" module
- `clearCatch()`: archives current live catch for org, calls revalidatePath("/")
- Follow existing server function patterns: requestInfo, hasAdminAccess check, return { success, error? }

## Part 4: Styles (src/app/pages/admin/catch/catch.css)
- BEM-like naming: `.catch-mic`, `.catch-mic__ring`, `.catch-mic__ring--recording`, `.catch-mic__timer`, `.catch-result`, etc.
- Use semantic design tokens ONLY (var(--color-*), var(--space-*), var(--radius-*))
- @keyframes for pulse animation (recording state)
- @keyframes for amplitude visualization
- Mobile-first: big touch targets, readable on small screens
- @media (max-width: 640px) adjustments if needed

## Part 5: Dashboard Nav Card + Route Registration

### AdminDashboardUI.tsx
- Add 4th nav card to the existing grid:
  - Icon: 🎙️ (microphone emoji)
  - Title: "Fresh Catch"
  - Description: "Record what's available this week"
  - Link: /admin/catch

### routes.ts (src/app/pages/admin/routes.ts)
- Import CatchPage from ./catch/CatchPage
- Add: route("/catch", CatchPage)

## Test Steps
1. Navigate to /admin/catch as admin user — page loads with mic button
2. See big mic button in idle state (120px+, ocean blue)
3. Tap mic — browser requests microphone permission
4. Grant permission — see recording state: red pulsing ring, countdown from 2:00
5. See audio level indicator responding to voice input (visual amplitude)
6. Tap again to stop — see processing spinner ("Transcribing & formatting...")
7. After processing: see formatted catch result with headline, items, summary
8. See "Re-record" button in done state
9. Wait 2 minutes while recording — auto-stops and auto-submits
10. Simulate upload failure: see error with both "Retry" and "Re-record" buttons
11. Tap "Retry" — re-uploads same audio without re-recording
12. Test "Clear catch" — archives current catch
13. Deny mic permission — see helpful permission-denied message with instructions
14. Navigate to /admin — see 4th "Fresh Catch" card with mic icon
15. Click "Fresh Catch" card — navigates to /admin/catch
16. Test on mobile viewport: mic button easy to tap with thumb
17. Verify all styles use semantic design tokens (no hardcoded hex)

2. Call the MCP tool via the local MCP endpoint (/mcp/:orgSlug) with session auth
3. Use the tool's response for the review/confirmation UI
4. On confirmation, the MCP tool handler executes the server function

This makes the admin command bar an MCP client, using the same tool definitions and handlers as external clients.

2. "Create popup" → MCP create_popup tool call
3. "Update market" → MCP update_market tool call

6. Cancel aborts the tool call
7. All existing command bar intents still work
8. Error in MCP tool → user-friendly error message in UI
9. No regression in command bar UX (speed, reliability)

title: Get bearings for Market context injection for voice updates
description:
# BEARINGS PHASE

## Goal
1. Verify the codebase is in a healthy state
2. Understand the relevant code for this task

## Task Context
Enhance the /api/voice/command endpoint to provide richer context when updating existing markets, enabling partial-change detection.

In src/api/voice-command.ts:
- When the LLM returns intent update_market or update_market_catch with a marketId:
  - Fetch full market from DB (all fields including catchPreview)
  - Option A (simpler): The initial prompt already includes all markets with their current state, so the LLM can compute the diff in one pass. Ensure buildCommandPrompt includes enough detail per market (name, schedule, type, active, subtitle, catchPreview summary)
  - Option B (two-pass, more accurate): After first pass identifies intent + target market, re-prompt with full market state asking for only changed fields. This is more token-expensive but more reliable.
  - Start with Option A. If field extraction quality is poor, upgrade to Option B.

- Market name matching: LLM returns marketId from the injected market list. If the market list includes IDs, the LLM can return the exact ID. If fuzzy matching needed, compare LLM-returned name against market names using simple substring/lowercase match.

- For update_market_catch: merge new catch preview with any existing catch preview if needed, or full replace

- Accept optional query param ?marketId=xxx for explicit targeting (e.g., from admin UI "update this market" button)

description:
# ORCHESTRATOR: Investigate and fix white screen after name entry

description:
# IMPLEMENTATION PHASE

## Goal
Make the code changes to implement the feature/fix.

## Task Context
Add always-visible quick action chip bar to chat with direct tool invocation (no LLM). Customers tap a chip, it calls the tool handler directly and returns formatted results.

## Changes Required

### New: src/app/pages/home/components/ChatQuickActions.tsx
Horizontal-scroll chip bar rendered above the chat input. Actions:
- 'What is fresh?' → tool: list_catch, args: {}
- 'Market schedule' → tool: get_markets, args: { activeOnly: true }
- 'Upcoming popups' → tool: get_vendor_popups, args: {}
- 'Place an order' → direct link to /orders/new (not AI, just navigation)
- 'Ask AI' → placeholder chip, visually muted/disabled for now (wired in Phase 3)

Style: pill buttons in horizontal scroll container. overflow-x: auto, scrollbar-width: none, gap: var(--space-sm). Pills use --color-surface-secondary bg, --color-text-primary text, --radius-full. Pressed state: --color-action-primary bg, --color-text-inverse text. 'Place an order' uses --color-action-secondary (coral).

### New: src/chat/tool-formatter.ts
Simple template-based formatter per tool. Converts raw JSON tool results into readable chat text. No LLM call.
- list_catch: 'Here is what is fresh today:\n• Mahi — caught this morning\n• ...' with headline and summary
- get_markets: 'Market schedule:\n• Adobe Ranch — Saturdays 8am-12pm\n• ...'  
- get_vendor_popups: 'Upcoming popups:\n• Spring Festival — April 15\n• ...'
Handle empty results gracefully ('No catch available right now', 'No upcoming popups', etc.)

### src/chat/durableObject.ts
New handler in webSocketMessage for type: ai-action:
```
interface AiActionMessage { type: 'ai-action'; tool: string; args: Record<string, unknown>; }
```
Flow:
1. Validate tool name is in allowed customer tools list (list_catch, get_markets, get_vendor_popups)
2. Budget check via McpDO (reuse existing pattern from handleAiResponse)
3. Call tool handler directly from src/api/tool-handlers.ts (handleListCatch, handleGetMarkets, handleGetVendorPopups)
4. Format result using tool-formatter.ts
5. Persist as senderType: 'ai' message in D1
6. Broadcast to all sockets

### src/app/pages/home/components/ChatSheet.tsx
- Import and render ChatQuickActions between message area and input form
- On chip tap: send { type: 'ai-action', tool, args } via WebSocket
- Also insert an optimistic customer-style message (e.g. 'What is fresh today?') so the thread reads naturally
- 'Place an order' chip navigates to /orders/new instead of sending WS message

1. Open chat — verify quick action chips visible above input at all times.
2. Tap 'What is fresh?' — verify optimistic customer message appears, then AI response with formatted catch data.
3. Tap 'Market schedule' — verify formatted market list appears as AI message.

5. Tap 'Place an order' — verify navigation to /orders/new page.
6. Verify 'Ask AI' chip is visible but muted/disabled.
7. Test with no catch data available — verify graceful 'No catch available' message.
8. Test budget exhaustion — verify friendly fallback message when McpDO budget check fails.
9. Verify quick actions work during active vendor conversation (not suppressed by takeover).
10. Horizontal scroll works on mobile — chips don't wrap, can scroll to see all.
11. Verify tool results are NOT going through LLM — check no Workers AI calls in logs for quick actions.
12. Verify AI messages from quick actions have senderType: 'ai' and show the AI label in chat.

4. verifyMagicToken returns {valid: true, email, sameDevice: false} for correct token + non-matching deviceId
5. verifyMagicToken returns {valid: false} for wrong token
6. verifyMagicToken returns {valid: false, expired: true} after 10 minutes
7. Same-device verification clears OTP state (single use)
8. Cross-device verification does NOT clear OTP state
9. Constant-time comparison used (XOR-based, no early exit)

## Task
**Category:** documentation

Document the OAuth 2.1 future direction in .choo-choo-ralph/mcp-oauth-direction.md:

1. Why OAuth 2.1 (MCP spec mandates for HTTP transports, third-party client support)
2. What it involves (authorization server endpoints, consent UI, token issuance, PKCE)

## Task Context
Security verification that customers cannot access admin tools through voice:

title: Diagnose Session DO operation error handling
description:
# DIAGNOSIS PHASE

## Goal
Understand the bug and find the root cause. Report findings back to orchestrator.

## Bug Context
sessions.save() in src/app/pages/admin/team/team-functions.ts ~line 223 and other DO operations can fail on timeout/eviction after idle (~1min). No error handling around these calls. Fix: add try-catch around sessions.save() and other DO operations in server functions. On failure, attempt retry once, then redirect to login if still failing. Related issues: #19.

## Test Steps
1. Leave admin page idle for 2+ minutes, then perform an action — should not whitescreen
2. Accept a team invite after idle — should work or gracefully redirect to login
3. Verify sessions.save() works normally in active usage
4. Test rapid navigation between pages that trigger session saves
5. Check that retry logic doesn't cause duplicate session entries
6. Verify error is logged when DO operation fails

comments.author: ptre
comments.text:
STATUS: REPRODUCIBLE
ROOT_CAUSE: All sessions.save(), sessions.load(), and sessions.remove() calls across server functions are unprotected. When a DO is evicted after idle (~1min on CF), the next RPC call can throw a network/timeout error. Since these are awaited with no try-catch, the error propagates as an unhandled rejection, causing whitescreen.
FILES: src/app/pages/admin/team/team-functions.ts (line 223), src/app/pages/user/org-functions.ts (line 60), src/app/pages/admin/functions.ts (lines 123,149,172,187,264), src/app/pages/user/functions.ts (lines 374,399,414,456,474), src/session/store.ts (rotateSession lines 59,77,80)
APPROACH: Create a resilient wrapper utility in src/session/store.ts that wraps DO operations with try-catch + single retry. On persistent failure, throw a SessionError that middleware can catch and redirect to login. Apply wrapper to all call sites.

13. L229: #6B7280 — fallback for config-empty-state color (followed by var(--cool-gray))
14. L241: #1A1A2E — fallback for config-empty-state__title (followed by var(--deep-navy))

OLD FLAT TOKEN REFS (should be semantic):
- L32: rgba(0,102,204,0.1) → var(--color-border-subtle)
- L134: var(--cool-gray) → var(--color-text-secondary)
- L146: var(--surface-primary) → var(--color-surface-primary)
- L149: rgba(100,116,139,0.1) → var(--color-border-subtle)
- L166: var(--surface-primary) → var(--color-surface-primary)
- L171: var(--light-gray) → var(--color-surface-secondary)
- L177: rgba(100,116,139,0.1) → var(--color-border-subtle)
- L196: var(--deep-navy) → var(--color-text-primary)
- L207: var(--cool-gray) → var(--color-text-secondary)
- L213: var(--cool-gray) → var(--color-text-secondary)
- L223: var(--surface-primary) → var(--color-surface-primary)
- L228: rgba(100,116,139,0.2) → var(--color-border-medium)
- L230: var(--cool-gray) → var(--color-text-secondary)
- L242: var(--deep-navy) → var(--color-text-primary)

MAPPING (hex fallback + old flat → semantic):
#6B7280 / var(--cool-gray)         → var(--color-text-secondary)
#1A1A2E / var(--deep-navy)         → var(--color-text-primary)
#F3F4F6 / var(--light-gray)        → var(--color-surface-secondary)
white / var(--surface-primary)      → var(--color-surface-primary)
#E8EFF5                             → var(--color-border-input) [already defined as #E8EFF5]
#CBD5E1                             → var(--color-border-input-disabled) [already defined as #CBD5E1]
rgba(0,102,204,0.1)                 → var(--color-border-subtle)
rgba(100,116,139,0.1)               → var(--color-border-subtle)
rgba(100,116,139,0.2)               → var(--color-border-medium)

APPROACH: Remove hex fallback lines entirely (the pattern is: hex on one line, var() override on next — just keep the var() line). Replace old flat token refs with semantic aliases. The rgba() border values map to existing semantic border tokens. Total: ~28 replacements across one file.

CONCERNS:
- #1A1A2E != #1A2B3D (deep-navy). The hex #1A1A2E is not the actual deep-navy value. Using var(--color-text-primary) which resolves to var(--deep-navy)=#1A2B3D is a slight color shift but correct per the design system.
- The hex+var() fallback pattern (hex first, then var() override) was for browser compat. Removing the hex line is safe since CSS custom properties have near-universal support now.
- Pre-existing TS errors in JoinUI.tsx (autoFocus prop) are unrelated and won't block this work.

description:

## Goal
Validate that the implementation works correctly through automated AND manual verification.

## Task Context
Add account lockout logic to loginWithPassword in functions.ts. DECISIONS:
- Kept audio/webm;codecs=opus as first priority (Chrome/Android) since it provides best quality. Safari will naturally fall through to audio/mp4.
- Did not add polyfill for MediaRecorder since Safari 14.3+ supports it natively and older versions are < 1% market share.

title: Commit Phase 4: Email notification overhaul — batching + inline collection
description:
# COMMIT PHASE

## Goal
Create a clean git commit with the changes.

## Task Context
Replace aggressive per-message email notifications with DO alarm-based batching. Replace intrusive EmailPromptBubble with integrated email collection in the away bar.

## Changes Required

### src/chat/durableObject.ts — Alarm-based batching
Replace the current 5-minute debounce email approach (lines 192-221) with:
1. When vendor sends message + customer offline (no customer sockets):
   - Append message preview to pendingEmailMessages array in DO storage
   - If no alarm set, schedule DO alarm for 15 minutes: this.ctx.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + 15 * 60 * 1000)
2. Add alarm() method to ChatDurableObject:
   - Read pendingEmailMessages from storage
   - If any exist, load conversation + org from D1
   - Send single batched email using sendChatReplyNotificationEmail with messageCount
   - Clear pendingEmailMessages from storage
3. When customer WebSocket connects (in fetch method):
   - Cancel any pending alarm: this.ctx.storage.deleteAlarm()
   - Clear pendingEmailMessages from storage (customer is back, no email needed)
4. Remove lastEmailSentAt field and EMAIL_DEBOUNCE_MS constant
5. Initialize pendingEmailMessages in blockConcurrencyWhile constructor

### src/emails/ChatReplyNotification.tsx
- Add messageCount prop (default 1)
- When messageCount > 1: subject becomes '{vendorName} sent you {count} messages'
- Body shows latest message preview + 'and {count - 1} more messages' text below
- When messageCount === 1: keep existing single-message format

### src/app/pages/home/components/ChatSheet.tsx — Integrated email collection
Replace EmailPromptBubble with email collection integrated into the away bar:
- When vendorOnline === false AND customer has no email on file (track via emailCollected state):

description:
# IMPLEMENTATION PHASE

## Goal
Make the code changes to implement the feature/fix.

## Task Context
Upgrade the MCP auth middleware to support API key authentication alongside session auth:

1. Check for Authorization: Bearer <key> header
2. If present: look up org from :orgSlug, hash the provided key, compare against org's apiKeyHash
3. If match: allow request with org context (role: "owner" for API key access)
4. If no match: 401
5. If no Authorization header: fall through to session auth (existing behavior)

API key auth should bypass origin validation (external clients don't have matching Origin).

3. Valid API key but wrong orgSlug → 401 (key doesn't match that org)
4. No Authorization header → falls through to session auth
5. Session auth still works when no API key provided
6. API key requests bypass origin validation
7. Revoked key (null hash) → 401
8. Auth check is fast (single DB query + hash comparison)

### CatchUI.tsx (src/app/pages/admin/catch/CatchUI.tsx)
- "use client" component
- State machine with states: idle | recording | processing | done | error | permission-denied

### Mic Button (centerpiece)
- 120px+ diameter circle, `border-radius: var(--radius-full)`
- Idle: ocean blue (`var(--color-action-primary)`), mic icon (SVG or emoji)
- Text below: "Tap to record what's fresh"
- Must be easy to tap with a big thumb on a dock

### Recording State
- Pulsing red ring animation (CSS keyframes)
- 2-minute countdown timer display (mm:ss format)
- Audio level indicator: use AudioContext + AnalyserNode
  - Connect MediaStream source to AnalyserNode
  - Read frequency data in requestAnimationFrame loop
  - Map amplitude to visual feedback (ring glow intensity or thickness pulsing with voice)
  - Evan needs to SEE the mic is picking up sound over dock wind/noise
- Auto-stop AND auto-submit at 0:00 (same behavior as manual stop)
- Text: "Recording... Tap to stop"

### MediaRecorder Integration
- MIME type detection: `MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported()`
  - Prefer `audio/webm;codecs=opus` (Chrome, Android)
  - Fallback: `audio/mp4` (Safari, iOS)
  - Fallback: `audio/webm`
- getUserMedia: `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: { echoCancellation: true, noiseSuppression: true } })`
- On stop: convert blob to ArrayBuffer, POST to /api/catch/record
- Release mic tracks on stop: `stream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop())`

### Error State (CRITICAL for dock use)
- RETAIN audio blob in memory on upload failure
- "Retry" button: re-uploads the SAME recording (no re-recording needed)
- "Re-record" button: separate, discards blob, returns to idle
- Error message displayed clearly
- Critical for spotty dock signal — don't lose a 2-minute recording on failure

### Permission Denied State
- Handle navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia rejection
- Show explanation: "Microphone access is needed to record your catch update"
- Instructions to re-enable in browser settings
- Retry button to request permission again

### Processing State
- Spinner animation
- Text: "Transcribing & formatting..."
- Non-interactive (no cancel, let it complete)

### Done State
- Green checkmark or success indicator
- Show formatted catch result (headline, item list, summary)
- "Re-record" button to start over
- "Clear catch" button to archive current live catch without replacing

### Current Live Catch Display
- Below the mic button area
- "Currently showing to customers:" header
- Render the current live catch data if exists
- Show "No catch currently displayed" if none

### Clear Catch
- Button that archives current live catch without recording new one
- Calls clearCatch() server function
- Use case: off-season, or Evan wants to stop showing catch

## Part 3: Server Functions (src/app/pages/admin/catch/catch-functions.ts)
- "use server" module
- `clearCatch()`: archives current live catch for org, calls revalidatePath("/")
- Follow existing server function patterns: requestInfo, hasAdminAccess check, return { success, error? }

## Part 4: Styles (src/app/pages/admin/catch/catch.css)
- BEM-like naming: `.catch-mic`, `.catch-mic__ring`, `.catch-mic__ring--recording`, `.catch-mic__timer`, `.catch-result`, etc.
- Use semantic design tokens ONLY (var(--color-*), var(--space-*), var(--radius-*))
- @keyframes for pulse animation (recording state)
- @keyframes for amplitude visualization
- Mobile-first: big touch targets, readable on small screens
- @media (max-width: 640px) adjustments if needed

## Part 5: Dashboard Nav Card + Route Registration

### AdminDashboardUI.tsx
- Add 4th nav card to the existing grid:
  - Icon: 🎙️ (microphone emoji)
  - Title: "Fresh Catch"
  - Description: "Record what's available this week"
  - Link: /admin/catch

### routes.ts (src/app/pages/admin/routes.ts)
- Import CatchPage from ./catch/CatchPage
- Add: route("/catch", CatchPage)

## Test Steps
1. Navigate to /admin/catch as admin user — page loads with mic button
2. See big mic button in idle state (120px+, ocean blue)
3. Tap mic — browser requests microphone permission
4. Grant permission — see recording state: red pulsing ring, countdown from 2:00
5. See audio level indicator responding to voice input (visual amplitude)
6. Tap again to stop — see processing spinner ("Transcribing & formatting...")
7. After processing: see formatted catch result with headline, items, summary

title: Commit Client: flow state machine + error states + success screen
description:
# COMMIT PHASE

## Goal
Create a clean git commit with the changes.

## Task Context
Wire all Login.tsx screens into a complete flow state machine. Flow type: 'email' | 'otp' | 'passkey-prompt' | 'name' | 'passkey-nudge' | 'success'. Transitions: email→otp (default) or email→passkey-prompt (if hint='passkey'), otp→name (if needsName) or otp→passkey-nudge (if !needsName && !hasPasskey) or otp→success (if hasPasskey), passkey-prompt→success (on biometric success) or passkey-prompt→otp (fallback), name→passkey-nudge, passkey-nudge→success. Success screen: 'You're in!' heading, 2-second countdown with 'Go now' link, redirect to /admin (isAdmin) or / (customer), respects ?b= parameter. Error states: inline errors below relevant inputs, rate limit countdowns with disabled buttons, network error with retry. Clean up ALL old Login.tsx code: remove 'login-password' and 'register' flow states, password fields, confirm password, password feedback, isBreachedPasswordLocal import, all password-related UI. Loading states: spinner in button, button disabled during API calls. Smooth transitions between screens (no hard page changes).

## Test Steps
1. Flow type correctly defined: email | otp | passkey-prompt | name | passkey-nudge | success
2. email→otp transition works on requestOtp success
3. email→passkey-prompt transition works when hint='passkey'
4. otp→name transition works when needsName=true
5. otp→passkey-nudge works when !needsName && !hasPasskey
6. otp→success works when returning user with passkey
7. passkey-prompt→success works on biometric success
8. passkey-prompt→otp fallback works
9. name→passkey-nudge transition works
10. passkey-nudge→success works (both set-up and skip paths)
11. Success screen shows countdown and redirects after 2s
12. Success redirect respects isAdmin flag (/admin vs /)
13. Success redirect includes ?b= parameter when present
14. No remnants of old flow states: 'login-password', 'register' are gone
15. No password fields, confirm password, or password feedback in component
16. No isBreachedPasswordLocal import
17. Loading states: buttons show spinner and disable during API calls
18. Network errors show 'Something went wrong' with retry button

## Instructions

1. **Review changes** - Run `git diff` to see all modifications
2. **Stage relevant files** - Only include files related to this task
3. **Write commit message** - Follow conventional commits format
4. **Create commit** - Use the commit skill or git directly

## Commit Message Format

```
<type>(<scope>): <description>

<body with details>

Refs: <bead-id>
```

Types: feat, fix, refactor, docs, test, chore

description:

## Task Context

title: Implement Server functions: requestOtp + verifyOtp + updateName + modify passkey registration
description:
# IMPLEMENTATION PHASE

## Goal
Make the code changes to implement the feature/fix.

## Task Context
Rewrite src/app/pages/user/functions.ts. Implement requestOtp(email): validate email, rate limit otpSend, anti-enumeration delay (200-500ms random), generate OTP via session DO saveOtp, send email via sendOtpEmail (fire-and-forget), check if user has passkey credentials, return {success, hint?: 'passkey'} — never reveal account existence. Implement verifyOtp(code, name?): rate limit otpVerify, call session DO verifyOtp, if valid lookup user by email (username field), if new user create User + individual Organization (type: individual, slug: uuid) + Membership (role: owner) + vendor membership if ?b= param, rotateSession, return {success, isAdmin, needsName, hasPasskey}. Implement updateName(name): requireCsrf, update user.name. Modify finishPasskeyRegistration: no longer creates User — only creates Credential record for existing logged-in user from session. Remove loginWithPassword, registerWithPassword, checkEmailExists entirely.

## Test Steps
1. requestOtp validates email format, returns {success: false} for invalid
2. requestOtp respects otpSend rate limit (3 per 15min)
3. requestOtp includes 200-500ms anti-enumeration delay
4. requestOtp returns {success: true} regardless of whether user exists
5. requestOtp returns {hint: 'passkey'} when user has credentials
6. requestOtp sends OTP email (or logs in dev mode)
7. verifyOtp returns error for wrong/expired/locked codes
8. verifyOtp creates new User + Organization + Membership for unknown email
9. verifyOtp creates vendor membership when ?b= param present
10. verifyOtp returns {needsName: true} for new users (name is null)
11. verifyOtp returns {needsName: false} for returning users with name set
12. verifyOtp calls rotateSession on success
13. verifyOtp returns correct isAdmin flag (business org + owner/manager role)
14. updateName requires valid CSRF token
15. updateName sets user.name in database
16. finishPasskeyRegistration creates Credential only (no User creation)
17. finishPasskeyRegistration requires logged-in session (userId in session)
18. loginWithPassword, registerWithPassword, checkEmailExists are deleted
19. All password-related imports removed from functions.ts

title: Get bearings for Infrastructure + Audio Processing Pipeline
description:
# BEARINGS PHASE

## Goal
1. Verify the codebase is in a healthy state
2. Understand the relevant code for this task

## Task Context
## Overview
Set up the complete backend for voice-to-catch: database model, Cloudflare AI binding, and the audio processing API endpoint that receives audio → transcribes via Whisper → formats via Claude → saves to DB.

## Part 1: CatchUpdate Database Model

Add CatchUpdate model to Prisma schema and create migration.

### Steps
- Add CatchUpdate model to `prisma/schema.prisma` with fields:
  - id (String, @id @default(uuid()))
  - organizationId (String, FK to Organization)
  - recordedBy (String?, nullable — tracks which admin recorded)
  - rawTranscript (String)
  - formattedContent (String — JSON: { headline, items[], summary })
  - status (String, @default("live")) — only "live" or "archived", no "processing" (that's in-flight only)
  - createdAt (DateTime @default(now()))
  - updatedAt (DateTime @updatedAt)
- Add `catchUpdates CatchUpdate[]` relation to the Organization model
- Create migration SQL file (next sequential number after existing migrations)
- Add indexes: @@index([organizationId]), @@index([organizationId, status])
- Run migrate:dev to apply locally
- Run generate to update Prisma client

## Part 2: Wrangler AI Binding

- Add `"ai": { "binding": "AI" }` to `wrangler.jsonc`
- Add comment noting ANTHROPIC_API_KEY must be set as Workers secret via `wrangler secret put ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`

## Part 3: Audio Processing API Endpoint

Create raw API endpoint at POST /api/catch/record.

### Architecture Decision (CRITICAL)
Register in `src/worker.tsx` AFTER session/user middleware but BEFORE `render(Document, [...])`. This gives full auth context (ctx.user, ctx.currentOrganization) while accessing raw request body. NOT before middleware like stripe webhook — that pattern is only for signature verification.

Add middleware handler pattern:
\`\`\`ts
// After session/user loading, before render()
async ({ ctx, request }) => {
  const url = new URL(request.url);
  if (request.method === "POST" && url.pathname === "/api/catch/record") {
    return handleCatchRecord(request, ctx);
  }
},
\`\`\`

### Implementation (src/api/catch-record.ts)
- Export `handleCatchRecord(request: Request, ctx: AppContext)` function
- Auth: verify ctx.user exists (401), verify hasAdminAccess(ctx) (403), verify ctx.currentOrganization (403)
- Read request body as ArrayBuffer
- Call Whisper: `env.AI.run("@cf/openai/whisper-tiny-en", { audio: [...new Uint8Array(body)] })` — use whisper-tiny-en (English-only, faster)
- Call Claude API via raw fetch to `https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages`:
  - Model: `claude-haiku-4-5-20241022` (cheapest/fastest, plenty for formatting)
  - Headers: `x-api-key` from env, `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01`, `content-type: application/json`
  - System prompt: enforce JSON-only output, structured list preserving Evan's colorful descriptions
  - Expected output shape: `{ headline: string, items: [{ name: string, note: string }], summary: string }`
- Robust JSON parsing:
  - Try JSON.parse directly
  - Fallback: strip \`\`\`json...\`\`\` markdown code fences, try again
  - Validate shape: headline (string), items (array of {name, note}), summary (string)
  - If all parsing fails, return error response with raw transcript text
- Archive existing live CatchUpdate for org: `db.catchUpdate.updateMany({ where: { organizationId, status: "live" }, data: { status: "archived" } })`
- Create new CatchUpdate: status "live", recordedBy = ctx.user.id
- Return JSON response with formatted content
- Env access: `import { env } from "cloudflare:workers"`, secrets via `(env as unknown as Record<string, string>).ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`

## Test Steps
1. Run `pnpm run migrate:dev` — no errors
2. Run `pnpm run generate` — Prisma client regenerates
3. Run `pnpm run types` — no type errors from schema changes
4. Verify wrangler.jsonc is valid (no syntax errors)
5. Run `pnpm run dev` — worker starts without binding errors
6. Verify handleCatchRecord is registered in worker.tsx after session middleware
7. Verify auth checks: function returns 401 without user, 403 without admin access
8. Verify Whisper call uses whisper-tiny-en model
9. Verify Claude call uses haiku model with JSON-only system prompt
10. Verify JSON parsing handles both raw JSON and code-fenced JSON
11. Verify old live CatchUpdate gets archived on new creation
12. Verify new CatchUpdate has recordedBy set to user ID
13. Verify error response includes raw transcript on Claude parse failure

If approaching 30-40% context usage with remaining work, create continuation beads for remaining items and exit cleanly.

title: Get bearings for Customer FreshSheet Display
description:
# BEARINGS PHASE

## Goal
1. Verify the codebase is in a healthy state
2. Understand the relevant code for this task

## Task Context
## Overview
Build the customer-facing FreshSheet component that displays Evan's formatted catch data on the home page. Integrate with the existing home page, replacing the hero section when fresh catch data exists. Include staleness auto-expiry (>7 days falls back to FreshHero).

## Part 1: FreshSheet Component (src/app/pages/home/components/FreshSheet.tsx)

### Design
- Ocean gradient card matching existing FreshHero style language:
  - `background: var(--color-gradient-primary)` (ocean blue → mint)
  - `border-radius: var(--radius-xl)`, `box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg)`
  - White text (--color-text-inverse)
  - Same width/margin as FreshHero: `width: calc(100% - var(--space-md) * 2)`, `max-width: var(--width-md)`, centered

### Content Structure
- "This Week's Catch" label at top (uppercase, small, letter-spaced — same as FreshHero V1 pattern)
- Headline from Claude output (large, bold, --font-size-4xl)
- Item list: each item shows fish name + Evan's descriptive note
  - e.g., "Redfish — beautiful fillets, just pulled in"
  - Use glassmorphic item cards or simple styled list items
  - Each item on its own line, readable
- "Updated X hours ago" relative timestamp at bottom
  - Use simple relative time calculation (no library needed)
  - "just now", "1 hour ago", "2 days ago", etc.
- "Order Now" CTA button at bottom
  - Links to /orders/new
  - Use coral gradient or action-secondary styling for prominence
  - Should stand out as the primary action

### Props Interface
```ts
type CatchData = {
  headline: string;
  items: { name: string; note: string }[];
  summary: string;
  updatedAt: string; // ISO date string
};
```

### Component is NOT "use client"
- This is a presentational component with no interactivity (no useState, no onClick handlers that need client)
- The "Order Now" button is just an `<a>` tag
- Relative timestamp can be computed at render time (server component)
- Keep it as a server component unless client interactivity is needed

## Part 2: Barrel Export
- Add to `src/app/pages/home/components/index.ts`:
  `export { FreshSheet } from './FreshSheet';`

## Part 3: Home Page Integration

### CustomerHome.tsx (server component)
- After fetching markets, also fetch latest live CatchUpdate for the org:
  ```ts
  const catchUpdate = await db.catchUpdate.findFirst({
    where: { organizationId: orgId, status: "live" },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }
  });
  ```
- Staleness check: only pass if ≤7 days old
  ```ts
  const STALE_DAYS = 7;
  const isStale = catchUpdate && (Date.now() - new Date(catchUpdate.createdAt).getTime()) > STALE_DAYS * 86400000;
  const catchData = catchUpdate && !isStale ? JSON.parse(catchUpdate.formattedContent) : null;
  ```
- Pass `catchData` (with updatedAt from catchUpdate.createdAt) to CustomerHomeUI
- Also pass existing props (markets, freshCatch, quickActions, ctx)

### CustomerHomeUI.tsx (client component)
- Add `catchData` to props type (CatchData | null)
- Conditional render in the hero section:
  - If catchData exists: `<FreshSheet catch={catchData} />`
  - If catchData is null: `<FreshHero actions={quickActions} />` (existing fallback)
- Import FreshSheet from ./components

## Test Steps
1. With live CatchUpdate (≤7d old) in DB: home page shows FreshSheet with formatted catch
2. FreshSheet shows "This Week's Catch" label, headline, items with notes
3. Each item displays fish name and Evan's note (e.g., "Redfish — beautiful fillets")
4. "Updated X hours ago" timestamp is accurate
5. "Order Now" button visible and links to /orders/new
6. With live CatchUpdate >7 days old: home page shows FreshHero fallback (quick actions)
7. Without any CatchUpdate: home page shows FreshHero with quick actions
8. Ocean gradient card matches existing hero aesthetic
9. Mobile: component looks good at 375px width

**Category:** infrastructure

title: Verify Admin Catch Recording UI
description:
# VERIFICATION PHASE

## Goal
Validate that the implementation works correctly through automated AND manual verification.

## Task Context
## Overview
Build the admin catch recording page (/admin/catch) with a massive dock-friendly mic button, integrate with the audio processing API (built in a prior task), add the dashboard nav card, and register the route. This is the full admin-side UI for voice-to-catch.

## Part 1: Admin Catch Page (Server Component)

### CatchPage.tsx (src/app/pages/admin/catch/CatchPage.tsx)
- Server component following existing pattern (see MarketConfigPage.tsx as reference)
- Auth check: hasAdminAccess(ctx), return appropriate error components if not
- Fetch latest live CatchUpdate for org: `db.catchUpdate.findFirst({ where: { organizationId: ctx.currentOrganization.id, status: "live" }, orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" } })`
- Pass currentCatch (or null) + ctx to CatchUI client component

## Part 2: Admin Catch UI (Client Component)

### CatchUI.tsx (src/app/pages/admin/catch/CatchUI.tsx)
- "use client" component
- State machine with states: idle | recording | processing | done | error | permission-denied

### Mic Button (centerpiece)
- 120px+ diameter circle, `border-radius: var(--radius-full)`
- Idle: ocean blue (`var(--color-action-primary)`), mic icon (SVG or emoji)
- Text below: "Tap to record what's fresh"
- Must be easy to tap with a big thumb on a dock

### Recording State
- Pulsing red ring animation (CSS keyframes)
- 2-minute countdown timer display (mm:ss format)
- Audio level indicator: use AudioContext + AnalyserNode
  - Connect MediaStream source to AnalyserNode
  - Read frequency data in requestAnimationFrame loop
  - Map amplitude to visual feedback (ring glow intensity or thickness pulsing with voice)
  - Evan needs to SEE the mic is picking up sound over dock wind/noise
- Auto-stop AND auto-submit at 0:00 (same behavior as manual stop)
- Text: "Recording... Tap to stop"

### MediaRecorder Integration
- MIME type detection: `MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported()`
  - Prefer `audio/webm;codecs=opus` (Chrome, Android)
  - Fallback: `audio/mp4` (Safari, iOS)
  - Fallback: `audio/webm`
- getUserMedia: `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: { echoCancellation: true, noiseSuppression: true } })`
- On stop: convert blob to ArrayBuffer, POST to /api/catch/record
- Release mic tracks on stop: `stream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop())`

### Error State (CRITICAL for dock use)
- RETAIN audio blob in memory on upload failure
- "Retry" button: re-uploads the SAME recording (no re-recording needed)
- "Re-record" button: separate, discards blob, returns to idle
- Error message displayed clearly
- Critical for spotty dock signal — don't lose a 2-minute recording on failure

### Permission Denied State
- Handle navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia rejection
- Show explanation: "Microphone access is needed to record your catch update"
- Instructions to re-enable in browser settings
- Retry button to request permission again

### Processing State
- Spinner animation
- Text: "Transcribing & formatting..."
- Non-interactive (no cancel, let it complete)

### Done State
- Green checkmark or success indicator
- Show formatted catch result (headline, item list, summary)
- "Re-record" button to start over
- "Clear catch" button to archive current live catch without replacing

### Current Live Catch Display
- Below the mic button area
- "Currently showing to customers:" header
- Render the current live catch data if exists
- Show "No catch currently displayed" if none

### Clear Catch
- Button that archives current live catch without recording new one
- Calls clearCatch() server function
- Use case: off-season, or Evan wants to stop showing catch

## Part 3: Server Functions (src/app/pages/admin/catch/catch-functions.ts)
- "use server" module
- `clearCatch()`: archives current live catch for org, calls revalidatePath("/")
- Follow existing server function patterns: requestInfo, hasAdminAccess check, return { success, error? }

## Part 4: Styles (src/app/pages/admin/catch/catch.css)
- BEM-like naming: `.catch-mic`, `.catch-mic__ring`, `.catch-mic__ring--recording`, `.catch-mic__timer`, `.catch-result`, etc.
- Use semantic design tokens ONLY (var(--color-*), var(--space-*), var(--radius-*))
- @keyframes for pulse animation (recording state)
- @keyframes for amplitude visualization
- Mobile-first: big touch targets, readable on small screens
- @media (max-width: 640px) adjustments if needed

## Part 5: Dashboard Nav Card + Route Registration

### AdminDashboardUI.tsx
- Add 4th nav card to the existing grid:
  - Icon: 🎙️ (microphone emoji)
  - Title: "Fresh Catch"
  - Description: "Record what's available this week"
  - Link: /admin/catch

### routes.ts (src/app/pages/admin/routes.ts)
- Import CatchPage from ./catch/CatchPage
- Add: route("/catch", CatchPage)

## Test Steps
1. Navigate to /admin/catch as admin user — page loads with mic button
2. See big mic button in idle state (120px+, ocean blue)
3. Tap mic — browser requests microphone permission
4. Grant permission — see recording state: red pulsing ring, countdown from 2:00
5. See audio level indicator responding to voice input (visual amplitude)
6. Tap again to stop — see processing spinner ("Transcribing & formatting...")
7. After processing: see formatted catch result with headline, items, summary
8. See "Re-record" button in done state
9. Wait 2 minutes while recording — auto-stops and auto-submits
10. Simulate upload failure: see error with both "Retry" and "Re-record" buttons
11. Tap "Retry" — re-uploads same audio without re-recording
12. Test "Clear catch" — archives current catch
13. Deny mic permission — see helpful permission-denied message with instructions
14. Navigate to /admin — see 4th "Fresh Catch" card with mic icon
15. Click "Fresh Catch" card — navigates to /admin/catch
16. Test on mobile viewport: mic button easy to tap with thumb
17. Verify all styles use semantic design tokens (no hardcoded hex)

title: Implement OtpState: add magicToken + deviceId, bump TTL to 10min
description:
# IMPLEMENTATION PHASE

## Goal

## Task Context
Extend OtpState in src/session/durableObject.ts with magicToken (64-byte crypto random, base64url) and deviceId (string) fields. Update saveOtp(email, deviceId) to generate magicToken alongside the OTP code. Add verifyMagicToken(token, submittedDeviceId) method: constant-time comparison (XOR-based), 10-min TTL, returns {valid, email?, expired?, sameDevice?}. Same-device: clear OTP state (single use). Cross-device: do NOT clear OTP (user can still enter code on original device). Bump verifyOtp TTL from 5 min to 10 min. title: Verify Infrastructure + Audio Processing Pipeline
description:
# VERIFICATION PHASE

## Goal
Validate that the implementation works correctly through automated AND manual verification.

## Task Context
## Overview
Set up the complete backend for voice-to-catch: database model, Cloudflare AI binding, and the audio processing API endpoint that receives audio → transcribes via Whisper → formats via Claude → saves to DB.

## Part 1: CatchUpdate Database Model

Add CatchUpdate model to Prisma schema and create migration.

### Steps
- Add CatchUpdate model to `prisma/schema.prisma` with fields:
  - id (String, @id @default(uuid()))
  - organizationId (String, FK to Organization)
  - recordedBy (String?, nullable — tracks which admin recorded)
  - rawTranscript (String)
  - formattedContent (String — JSON: { headline, items[], summary })
  - status (String, @default("live")) — only "live" or "archived", no "processing" (that's in-flight only)
  - createdAt (DateTime @default(now()))
  - updatedAt (DateTime @updatedAt)
- Add `catchUpdates CatchUpdate[]` relation to the Organization model
- Create migration SQL file (next sequential number after existing migrations)
- Add indexes: @@index([organizationId]), @@index([organizationId, status])
- Run migrate:dev to apply locally
- Run generate to update Prisma client

## Part 2: Wrangler AI Binding

- Add `"ai": { "binding": "AI" }` to `wrangler.jsonc`
- Add comment noting ANTHROPIC_API_KEY must be set as Workers secret via `wrangler secret put ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`

## Part 3: Audio Processing API Endpoint

Create raw API endpoint at POST /api/catch/record.

### Architecture Decision (CRITICAL)
Register in `src/worker.tsx` AFTER session/user middleware but BEFORE `render(Document, [...])`. This gives full auth context (ctx.user, ctx.currentOrganization) while accessing raw request body. NOT before middleware like stripe webhook — that pattern is only for signature verification.

Add middleware handler pattern:
\`\`\`ts
// After session/user loading, before render()
async ({ ctx, request }) => {
  const url = new URL(request.url);
  if (request.method === "POST" && url.pathname === "/api/catch/record") {
    return handleCatchRecord(request, ctx);
  }
},
\`\`\`

### Implementation (src/api/catch-record.ts)
- Export `handleCatchRecord(request: Request, ctx: AppContext)` function
- Auth: verify ctx.user exists (401), verify hasAdminAccess(ctx) (403), verify ctx.currentOrganization (403)
- Read request body as ArrayBuffer
- Call Whisper: `env.AI.run("@cf/openai/whisper-tiny-en", { audio: [...new Uint8Array(body)] })` — use whisper-tiny-en (English-only, faster)
- Call Claude API via raw fetch to `https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages`:
  - Model: `claude-haiku-4-5-20241022` (cheapest/fastest, plenty for formatting)
  - Headers: `x-api-key` from env, `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01`, `content-type: application/json`
  - System prompt: enforce JSON-only output, structured list preserving Evan's colorful descriptions
  - Expected output shape: `{ headline: string, items: [{ name: string, note: string }], summary: string }`
- Robust JSON parsing:
  - Try JSON.parse directly
  - Fallback: strip \`\`\`json...\`\`\` markdown code fences, try again
  - Validate shape: headline (string), items (array of {name, note}), summary (string)
  - If all parsing fails, return error response with raw transcript text
- Archive existing live CatchUpdate for org: `db.catchUpdate.updateMany({ where: { organizationId, status: "live" }, data: { status: "archived" } })`
- Create new CatchUpdate: status "live", recordedBy = ctx.user.id
- Return JSON response with formatted content
- Env access: `import { env } from "cloudflare:workers"`, secrets via `(env as unknown as Record<string, string>).ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`

## Test Steps
1. Run `pnpm run migrate:dev` — no errors
2. Run `pnpm run generate` — Prisma client regenerates
3. Run `pnpm run types` — no type errors from schema changes
4. Verify wrangler.jsonc is valid (no syntax errors)
5. Run `pnpm run dev` — worker starts without binding errors
6. Verify handleCatchRecord is registered in worker.tsx after session middleware
7. Verify auth checks: function returns 401 without user, 403 without admin access
8. Verify Whisper call uses whisper-tiny-en model
9. Verify Claude call uses haiku model with JSON-only system prompt
10. Verify JSON parsing handles both raw JSON and code-fenced JSON
11. Verify old live CatchUpdate gets archived on new creation
12. Verify new CatchUpdate has recordedBy set to user ID
13. Verify error response includes raw transcript on Claude parse failure

## Context Window Management
If approaching 30-40% context usage with remaining work, create continuation beads for remaining items and exit cleanly.

## Automated Checks

1. **Run type checking** - Check CLAUDE.md or package.json for commands (e.g., `bun typecheck`)
2. **Run tests** - Execute test suite (e.g., `bun test`)
3. **Run linting** - If available, run the linter

3. Save screenshots to `.choo-choo-ralph/screenshots/` for verification

2. Re-run verification
3. Continue if passes

### Significant Issues (architectural, doesn't meet spec)

title: Customer FreshSheet Display
description:
# ORCHESTRATOR: Customer FreshSheet Display

You coordinate child steps for this task.

## Task
**Category:** functional

## Overview
Build the customer-facing FreshSheet component that displays Evan's formatted catch data on the home page. Integrate with the existing home page, replacing the hero section when fresh catch data exists. Include staleness auto-expiry (>7 days falls back to FreshHero).

## Part 1: FreshSheet Component (src/app/pages/home/components/FreshSheet.tsx)

### Design
- Ocean gradient card matching existing FreshHero style language:
  - `background: var(--color-gradient-primary)` (ocean blue → mint)
  - `border-radius: var(--radius-xl)`, `box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg)`
  - White text (--color-text-inverse)
  - Same width/margin as FreshHero: `width: calc(100% - var(--space-md) * 2)`, `max-width: var(--width-md)`, centered

### Content Structure
- "This Week's Catch" label at top (uppercase, small, letter-spaced — same as FreshHero V1 pattern)
- Headline from Claude output (large, bold, --font-size-4xl)
- Item list: each item shows fish name + Evan's descriptive note
  - e.g., "Redfish — beautiful fillets, just pulled in"
  - Use glassmorphic item cards or simple styled list items
  - Each item on its own line, readable
- "Updated X hours ago" relative timestamp at bottom
  - Use simple relative time calculation (no library needed)
  - "just now", "1 hour ago", "2 days ago", etc.
- "Order Now" CTA button at bottom
  - Links to /orders/new
  - Use coral gradient or action-secondary styling for prominence
  - Should stand out as the primary action

### Props Interface
```ts
type CatchData = {
  headline: string;
  items: { name: string; note: string }[];
  summary: string;
  updatedAt: string; // ISO date string
};
```

### Component is NOT "use client"
- This is a presentational component with no interactivity (no useState, no onClick handlers that need client)
- The "Order Now" button is just an `<a>` tag
- Relative timestamp can be computed at render time (server component)
- Keep it as a server component unless client interactivity is needed

## Part 2: Barrel Export
- Add to `src/app/pages/home/components/index.ts`:
  `export { FreshSheet } from './FreshSheet';`

## Part 3: Home Page Integration

### CustomerHome.tsx (server component)
- After fetching markets, also fetch latest live CatchUpdate for the org:
  ```ts
  const catchUpdate = await db.catchUpdate.findFirst({
    where: { organizationId: orgId, status: "live" },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }
  });
  ```
- Staleness check: only pass if ≤7 days old
  ```ts
  const STALE_DAYS = 7;
  const isStale = catchUpdate && (Date.now() - new Date(catchUpdate.createdAt).getTime()) > STALE_DAYS * 86400000;
  const catchData = catchUpdate && !isStale ? JSON.parse(catchUpdate.formattedContent) : null;
  ```
- Pass `catchData` (with updatedAt from catchUpdate.createdAt) to CustomerHomeUI
- Also pass existing props (markets, freshCatch, quickActions, ctx)

### CustomerHomeUI.tsx (client component)
- Add `catchData` to props type (CatchData | null)
- Conditional render in the hero section:
  - If catchData exists: `<FreshSheet catch={catchData} />`
  - If catchData is null: `<FreshHero actions={quickActions} />` (existing fallback)
- Import FreshSheet from ./components

## Test Steps
1. With live CatchUpdate (≤7d old) in DB: home page shows FreshSheet with formatted catch
2. FreshSheet shows "This Week's Catch" label, headline, items with notes
3. Each item displays fish name and Evan's note (e.g., "Redfish — beautiful fillets")
4. "Updated X hours ago" timestamp is accurate
5. "Order Now" button visible and links to /orders/new
6. With live CatchUpdate >7 days old: home page shows FreshHero fallback (quick actions)
7. Without any CatchUpdate: home page shows FreshHero with quick actions
8. Ocean gradient card matches existing hero aesthetic
9. Mobile: component looks good at 375px width
10. Text is readable (white on gradient, proper contrast)
11. Verify no client-side JavaScript needed (pure server component)

description:
# BEARINGS PHASE

## Task Context
Wire all Login.tsx screens into a complete flow state machine. Flow type: 'email' | 'otp' | 'passkey-prompt' | 'name' | 'passkey-nudge' | 'success'. Transitions: email→otp (default) or email→passkey-prompt (if hint='passkey'), otp→name (if needsName) or otp→passkey-nudge (if !needsName && !hasPasskey) or otp→success (if hasPasskey), passkey-prompt→success (on biometric success) or passkey-prompt→otp (fallback), name→passkey-nudge, passkey-nudge→success. Success screen: 'You're in!' heading, 2-second countdown with 'Go now' link, redirect to /admin (isAdmin) or / (customer), respects ?b= parameter. Error states: inline errors below relevant inputs, rate limit countdowns with disabled buttons, network error with retry. Clean up ALL old Login.tsx code: remove 'login-password' and 'register' flow states, password fields, confirm password, password feedback, isBreachedPasswordLocal import, all password-related UI. Loading states: spinner in button, button disabled during API calls. Smooth transitions between screens (no hard page changes).

## Test Steps
1. Flow type correctly defined: email | otp | passkey-prompt | name | passkey-nudge | success
2. email→otp transition works on requestOtp success
3. email→passkey-prompt transition works when hint='passkey'
4. otp→name transition works when needsName=true

9. name→passkey-nudge transition works

13. Success redirect includes ?b= parameter when present
14. No remnants of old flow states: 'login-password', 'register' are gone
15. No password fields, confirm password, or password feedback in component

# COMMIT PHASE

## Goal
Create a clean git commit with the changes.

## Task Context
Implement vendor online/offline detection for the chat system. When a vendor has an active WebSocket connection to the ChatDurableObject with role "vendor", they're online. When no vendor WebSocket is connected, they're offline.

Add a method to check vendor presence: either query the ChatDurableObject or track presence state. This will be used to decide whether AI should respond to customer messages.

## Test Steps

description:
# ORCHESTRATOR: Implement account lockout logic in loginWithPassword

You coordinate child steps for this task.

## Task
**Category:** security

Add account lockout logic to loginWithPassword in functions.ts. After 5 failed attempts, lock account for 15 minutes.\n\n### Steps\n- Before password check: if lockedUntil > now, return generic 'Invalid email or password' error\n- If lockedUntil < now, treat as unlocked (reset on next successful login)\n- On failed password: increment failedAttempts, if >= 5 set lockedUntil = now + 15 min\n- On successful login: reset failedAttempts to 0 and lockedUntil to null\n- Same error message for locked, wrong password, and non-existent user\n\n### Test Steps\n1. description:
# IMPLEMENTATION PHASE

## Goal
